profile.name: SHFQA量子分析仪
profile.description: 这是一台用于量子测量的射频/微波量子分析仪，证据显示其支持示波采集、QA通道配置、序列器程序加载、波形写入、读出积分权重设置、结果记录以及多能级量子态读出等功能，常用于超导量子比特实验中的激励与读出测量。
profile.description_en: This is an RF/microwave quantum analyzer for quantum measurements. The evidence shows support for scope acquisition, QA channel configuration, sequencer program loading, waveform transfer, readout integration weights, result logging, and multi-state qudit readout, as commonly used in superconducting qubit excitation and readout experiments.
